title: Removal of 34 street trees at 4900-5200 Vineland Ave. North Hollywood and 1500-2700 W. Colorado: Other: North Hollywood to Pasadena Bus Rapid Transit Project
text:
[Proposed street tree removal posted by StreetsLA Urban Forestry]
Posting ID: 1071
Address or Location: 4900-5200 Vineland Ave. North Hollywood and 1500-2700 W. Colorado
Posting Date: 10/16/2026
Removal Reason: Other: North Hollywood to Pasadena Bus Rapid Transit Project

summary: StreetsLA has posted a proposal to remove 34 street trees along Vineland Avenue and West Colorado Boulevard to make way for the North Hollywood to Pasadena Bus Rapid Transit project.
